verdict.rationale: Inngest documents an official MCP server (inngest.com/docs/ai-dev-tools/mcp) explicitly designed to let MCP clients like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor connect and inspect/operate Inngest, confirmed via a live probe. As Inngest is a workflow platform rather than an agent itself, this axis applies and is met by first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the MCP server works reliably in practice.
